about:
Witonics operates from Ames, Iowa, as an online retailer of electronic components and repair kits. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company stocks a wide range of fuses — glass, ceramic, automotive, thermal, pico, and microwave types — from brands such as Bussmann, Littelfuse, Ferraz Shawmut (Mersen), Daito, Fuji, and SIBA. It also offers capacitor replacement kits for television and monitor power or inverter boards, along with individual capacitors, ICs, semiconductors, resistors, transistors, and diodes. Witonics notes that it is not an authorized distributor for Bussmann, Littelfuse, or Mersen products.

The business serves customers needing automotive fuses and electronic repair parts, including hobbyists, repair technicians, and service shops that replace capacitors in consumer displays. The product catalog spans industrial fuse series and component-level kits for board-level repair.

Witonics emphasizes RoHS-compliant inventory and fast shipping, with customer reviews highlighting quick delivery and responsive service. The capacitor kits target common failure symptoms such as slow startup, flickering screens, clicking noises, and power-LED issues in TVs and monitors.
